responseLimits.context: WebClient.builder plus production SupplierClientConfiguration; not Boot-injected clients for large-body probes

poolConfiguration.scope: pool key includes remote address and channel configuration; not one global Supplier limit

limitations: Allocation is caller-thread cumulative bytes, not live or peak heap. It excludes fixture/projection creation, real HTTP/JSON, asynchronous threads and native memory.
Thread allocation includes logging and small measurement bookkeeping. Three warmups precede five samples.
Graph measurement sums shallow sizes of uniquely reachable objects, excludes static fields and stops traversing enum/Class references.
Graph sizes are not dominator-retained heap, serialized JSON, RSS or a load-test capacity estimate. Shared objects prevent simple summation of application and response graphs.

reproduction.restore: Restore each probeSources text to its relativeToScratchDirectory under scratchDirectory. Paths in init scripts assume that scratch directory. Sources are audit-only and assert current behavior; they are not permanent regression tests.
agentBuild: Create agent/MANIFEST.MF with Premain-Class: audit.SizeAgent followed by a blank line
prerequisites: Java 21 for javac, jar and Gradle
Run agent build from scratch directory; run Gradle commands from repository
Gradle access to dependencies; temporary local ports
Capture each Gradle output separately: the second run replaces the first JUnit XML output directory
